_avail.description: AVB Beamtracking ceiling microphone with PoE+ amplifier, white pendant
_avail.portsMissing: Sheet says '4-pin 5.08 mm Phoenix connectors' for 2 channels without saying one shared block or one per channel; modelled as one port per channel. Pendant mic to plenum box (2-pin 3.5 mm Phoenix) is internal to the product, not modelled. Card White says PoE 802.3af class 3 / 15.4 W, the sheet says PoE+ class 4, 30 W - card should be checked.
_avail.notes: PoE from the manufacturer's document (takes precedence over the catalog card): "PoE+ (IEEE 802.3at Class 4, 30W) amplifier" — https://products.biamp.com/api/media/file/biamp_data_sheet_parle_tcm-1a_jul22_2040.pdf; the card had PoE 802.3af class 3, poeDrawW 15.4

ports.label: Speaker Out 1
ports.notes: 4-pin 5.08 mm Phoenix; 4 W continuous (8 W single channel), burst 40 W / 4 ohm, 30 W / 8 ohm

ports.label: Speaker Out 2
ports.notes: 4-pin 5.08 mm Phoenix; 4 W continuous, burst 40 W / 4 ohm, 30 W / 8 ohm; inactive in single-channel mode

ports.label: AVB/Control (PoE+)
ports.notes: To a Tesira AVB port via PoE+ injector or a PoE+ AVB switch; PoE+ 802.3at class 4, 30 W

ports.label: Mic In (TCM-1EX)
ports.notes: Daisy-chain up to two TCM-1EX expansion mics, up to 10 m between plenum boxes
